inputs.label: X-Wing Alliance game ZIP
inputs.help: On your PC, zip the contents of your installed X-Wing Alliance folder (GOG, Steam or CD), so that RESDATA.TXT is at the top of the zip.

steps.why: The app creates its import folders. Files copied with a plain adb push belong to the wrong user, so the app unpacks the zip itself.
The app unpacks openxwa-import.zip into its own storage.

steps.text: Open OpenXWA from Library > Unknown sources.

otherWays.label: OpenXWA VR Launcher
otherWays.help: Run OpenXWA-VR-Launcher.exe from OpenXWA-Quest-<version>.zip on Windows. It finds your X-Wing Alliance, installs the game, copies and checks the game files and can bring your PC pilots along. You need no game zip.

notes: Follows the manual install from README.txt in the release zip. The normal path is OpenXWA-VR-Launcher.exe (in the same zip), a Windows program that installs the app, copies about 1 GB of game files, checks them and can bring PC pilots along; qgp could later zip the pc-install itself instead. Releases also carry a PCVR zip. Steam app ID 361670 (from the guide) is not needed while the input is a zip.
